messages:
natalie: quick sync — ran a long-form throughput sweep on Mistral-7B with paged-KV and MQA enabled, saw a sharp drop at seq=1024 when kernel=auto selected conv-fused kernel. raw numbers below.

enrico: paste the numbers? :eyes:

natalie: here's the micro-bench (50 warmup, 200 iters, bs=1 continuous batching):

```
before (conv-fused): seq=512 -> 380 tok/s, p99=42ms
seq=1024 -> 190 tok/s, p99=110ms
mem (gpu): 11.2GB page faults spiky

after (matmul-native + kv-tiling hint): seq=1024 -> 295 tok/s, p99=56ms
```

natalie: profiler traces point at repeated KV page-in / eviction cycles every ~18 requests, looks like fragmentation + eviction thrash rather than compute.
aaron: hmm, does MQA mapping mismatch num_key_value_heads vs attention heads? that's a common source of fragmentation — we saw similar for Mixtral with stride misalign.
maya: added perf counters from the runtime: kernel_selector picked conv-fused because it estimated lower FLOPs for seq<768; but it didn't consider the cost of paged KV I/O. trace snippet: `kernel=conv-fused, kv_layout=paged|slot_count=16384, evict_rate=0.27 ops/sec`
zane: can you share the exact config you ran? I'll try a repro locally.

natalie: config snippet:

```
model: mistral-7b
mq_mode: MQA
num_key_value_heads: 16
kv_dim: 128
kv_layout: paged
page_size: 256KB
disable_kernel_hints: false
continuous_batch_window_ms: 8
```

zane: thanks — hypothesis: conv-fused kernel has a different access pattern for KV cache (interleaved heads) that causes more non-contiguous page reads when num_key_value_heads != heads/stride. That increases page faults and stalls. two easy tests: 1) force matmul-native kernel 2) align num_key_value_heads to physical head groups and rerun.

enrico: also try bumping continuous_batch_window to 16ms to reduce micro-bursting which can exacerbate eviction churn.

maya: I ran the two tests: forcing matmul-native improved throughput ~55% at seq=1024, but also increased peak memory by ~200MB. aligning num_key_value_heads -> 32 (match 32 attention heads) reduced page faults by 70% and gave stable latency. combined gave the best win. new numbers:

```
forced-matmul + aligned-kv-heads: seq=1024 -> 315 tok/s, p99=52ms, mem=11.4GB
forced-matmul + original-kv-heads: seq=1024 -> 240 tok/s, p99=75ms
```

aaron: so two levers: kernel selection and KV-head alignment. but we need an automated guard so kernel selector accounts for page-I/O when paged-KV is enabled.

natalie: agreed. I sketched a quick patch for kernel selection: penalty heuristics when kv_layout==paged -> add estimated page-read cost = est_pages * page_penalty_ms then prefer matmul-native when page_cost > threshold. rough pseudo: `score = compute_estimate + page_cost * w_io`.

enrico: nice. we should also add a batching heuristic: if continuous_batch_window_ms < 12ms and backend reports higher evict_rate, temporarily increase window to avoid oscillation. We have telemetry for evict_rate in console so it can be automated.

zane: I'll prototype a runtime flag `runtime.kv.page_io_awareness=true` that flips the score. Also add an escape hatch via env `RW_KERNEL_SELECTOR_FORCE` for canarying.

deploy-bot: deploy request queued: branches/rw/kernel-kv-awareness -> staging (canary on 2 hosts) :rocket:

natalie: small follow-up after canary (on staging): 12-hour soak with mixed short/long seq. results: canary hosts showed 30-60% fewer page reads per request and a 20% lower p99 for long queries. one regression: mixtral-compact variant saw a 3% throughput dip for seq<256 due to noisy matmul kernel under tiny seqs.

enrico: that's acceptable if we gate by seq_len and kv_layout. kernel-selector should still allow conv-fused for seq<512 when page_eviction_rate low.

aaron: longer-term: consider a kv-layout rewrite to add a hot-slot prefetch for first N tokens of a convo to avoid cold page reads. also investigate compacting paged slots to reduce fragmentation. both are moderate-risk infra changes.

maya: logged follow-up tickets: INFRA-3246 (kernel selector page-awareness), RUNTIME-4123 (adaptive batching window), KV-881 (paged-slot compaction prototype). I'll add the perf traces and profiler flamegraphs to the tickets.

natalie: plan for next week: ship kernel-selector guard behind `runtime.kv.page_io_awareness` default off, enable for dedicated nodes first, monitor console eviction_rate and token-latency SLOs. Also update model onboarding docs to recommend num_key_value_heads alignments for GQA/MQA variants (add examples for Llama / Mistral / Mixtral / Qwen).

zane: I'll open the PR with tests + microbench harness reproducer.

natalie: nice work everyone. :thumbsup:

maya: quick note — on Qwen-7B we saw similar but with different threshold (page_cost kicks in at seq=768). so probably model-specific defaults in onboarding make sense.

enrico: copying this thread to eng-runtime-ops channel for visibility.
